messages:
maria_cs: Hi team — kicking off handoff for the secure egress & firewall config for Pelorus (private deployment). Need final sign-off on network rules, IAM scoping, KMS key policy, and audit-log routing before go-live next Wed. Quick checklist below, please ack and add blockers. :calendar:

maria_cs: Checklist (high level):
- egress/NAT / firewall rules + allowed outbound destinations
- cross-account IAM roles + least-privilege policies
- KMS CMK creation + admin/usage policies + rotation windows
- CloudTrail audit-log exports (splunk) + latency/S3 lifecycle
- ops runbook and rollback steps

devin_se: I can take the network bits. Two Qs: do we allow direct outbound to 3rd-party telemetry endpoints (SaaS analytics), or must all egress go via proxy? Also need the exact CIDR ranges for the customer VPC and the Redwood peering subnet.

maria_cs: Pelorus asked for proxy-only egress (security req). I have their VPC CIDR: 10.212.0.0/16, and redwood-peers: 10.20.48.0/24. I'll drop the formal network diagram in the shared drive after this thread.

devin_se: Cool. For firewall rules I'll propose: allow outbound to proxy (10.20.48.10:3128), allow DNS (UDP/53) to resolver, allow NTP. Block direct 443/80 to external IPs unless initiated by proxy. Sample SG below:

```
# security group (egress)
allow: tcp 10.20.48.10:3128
allow: udp 10.20.48.2:53
allow: udp 169.254.169.254:80 # IMDS if needed
deny: 0.0.0.0/0:443 except proxy
```

sophie_security: KMS notes: Pelorus requires CMKs with an admin ACL containing their security-ops role and Redwood KMS service principal. We must ensure key policy allows Encrypt/Decrypt for the inference nodes and Decrypt for the dedicated autoscaler role. Also set key rotation to 365 days; rotation is customer policy.

raj_platform: For IAM, we'll create a cross-account role in their account with a trust policy constrained to Redwood's deployment principal (arn:aws:iam::REDWOOD-DEPLOY:role/runner). Policy attachments: minimal S3 read/write for logs, kms:Decrypt on the CMK alias, ec2:Describe* for health-checks. I'll draft the role in terraform and post snippet.

ops_tim: Audit logs: Pelorus wants CloudTrail events shipped to their Splunk instance with <=15m delivery SLA. We'll set up a dedicated S3 bucket (pelorus-audit-redwood), configure CloudTrail, and use Kinesis Firehose to forward to Splunk HEC. Need to confirm Splunk HEC endpoint and token. Also lifecycle policy: 90d then Glacier.

maria_cs: Recording action items and owners:
- network / firewall config: devin_se (deliver tf + SG rules by Thursday)
- IAM role + policies: raj_platform (draft role + least-priv policy by Friday)
- KMS key policy + rotation: sophie_security (policy template + customer-facing doc)
- Audit pipeline + Splunk HEC: ops_tim (confirm endpoint + test events)
- Runbook + rollback: maria_cs & devin_se (runbook draft)

maria_cs: Renewal risk note: Pelorus is on the cusp of committing to a dedicated plan; outstanding security items + KMS key ownership questions are the primary friction. If we resolve KMS admin separation and provide an ops runbook by EOD Friday, CS sees minimal risk to deal.

devin_se: One small blocker: the customer's proxy team needs TLS inspection cert pinned on our side. Can sophie_security confirm if we can accept their CA or if we need a mutual TLS setup?

sophie_security: We prefer pinning their intermediate CA in the proxy config. Mutual TLS is heavier; try CA pin first. Also need to validate that KMS key policy does not grant full kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion to customer admin role — that must stay with Redwood.

raj_platform: Terraform snippet (cross-account role):
```
resource "aws_iam_role" "pelorus_cross" {
  name = "redwood-deploy-pelorus"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.trust.json
}
```
I'll push full module to the repo under infra/pelorus by EOD.

ops_tim: Pelorus provided Splunk HEC: https://splunk-pelorus.example.com:8088, token shared via 1Password. I'll run a smoke test once role & bucket exist.

aws-deploy-bot: Deployment check: no infra changes yet. Waiting on terraform plan from raj_platform and sg rules from devin_se.

maria_cs: Thanks all — please react with :white_check_mark: when your item is done. I'll host a 30-min sync Monday 9am PT to walk through the runbook and confirm cutover window. Add any follow-ups here.

devin_se: Acked. Will post TF plan in #infra-reviews and ping here when ready. :thumbsup:

sophie_security: Will upload KMS policy template and annotated key policy this afternoon.

raj_platform: Plan to open PR by 8pm PT.

ops_tim: Smoke test scheduled for Tuesday 3pm PT.

maria_cs: Great — closing loop for now. If anything shifts, ping me directly. :rocket:
